title: Dependency injection fails silently when using async generators with lifespan
body: When using async generator dependencies in combination with the lifespan context manager, the cleanup phase of the generator is sometimes skipped. This results in resource leaks that are difficult to debug. I can reproduce this consistently on FastAPI 0.115.5 with Python 3.12.

title: Add support for OpenAPI 3.1 discriminator with anyOf schemas
body: FastAPI currently supports OpenAPI 3.0 discriminators but does not fully support the anyOf pattern with discriminators introduced in OpenAPI 3.1. This enhancement would allow better polymorphic schemas to be expressed through the automatic schema generation.

title: How to properly type response_model with generic types?
body: I'm trying to use a generic Pydantic model as a response_model but getting type errors from mypy. The documentation doesn't have a clear example of this pattern.

title: WebSocket connection drops unexpectedly with large payloads
body: When sending WebSocket messages larger than 64KB, the connection drops without any error in the client. This seems related to the starlette WebSocket implementation but manifests in FastAPI apps. Smaller payloads work fine.

title: Improve documentation for OAuth2 with refresh tokens
body: The current OAuth2 documentation only covers the password flow with access tokens. A clear example showing how to implement refresh token rotation would be very helpful for production deployments.

title: TypeError when using Annotated with complex nested models
body: Using `Annotated[MyModel, Field(...)]` with deeply nested Pydantic v2 models raises a TypeError during startup schema generation. This regression appeared in 0.115.4.

title: Good first issue: add example for file streaming responses
body: The docs show how to return a FileResponse but not how to stream large files without loading them fully into memory. A streaming iterator example using StreamingResponse would help many users.

title: Background tasks not running when using TestClient
body: BackgroundTask objects added to a response don't execute when using the synchronous TestClient. This makes it impossible to test background task side effects. The async client works as expected.

title: Support for HTTP/2 server push in responses
body: Is there any plan to expose HTTP/2 server push via a FastAPI API? This would be useful for pushing related resources proactively to improve page load performance.

title: Path parameter validation regex patterns not documented clearly
body: The docs mention that path parameters support regex patterns but do not explain the syntax clearly. An example showing how to constrain a path parameter to only alphanumeric values would be beneficial.

title: Middleware ordering affects CORS headers on error responses
body: When CORSMiddleware is added after custom exception handlers, 422 validation error responses do not include the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. This causes frontend applications to receive an opaque error instead of the validation details.

title: Allow custom JSON encoder for specific response types
body: The global json_encoders configuration via Pydantic model_config works but cannot be overridden per-route. A per-response-type JSON encoder would allow returning special numeric types or date formats in specific endpoints.

title: Startup event not triggered in sub-applications
body: When mounting a FastAPI app as a sub-application using app.mount(), the sub-application's on_startup handlers and lifespan context are not called. This causes database connections and other initialization to fail silently.

title: Add native support for Server-Sent Events
body: Currently SSE requires manually crafting text/event-stream responses. A first-class EventSourceResponse helper similar to WebSocket handling would greatly simplify real-time streaming use cases.

title: Incorrect Content-Type header when returning bytes from endpoint
body: Returning raw bytes from a route function sets Content-Type to application/json instead of application/octet-stream. The fix was confirmed and merged.

title: Include examples for using custom validators with Query parameters
body: The documentation covers basic query parameter types but lacks examples for custom Pydantic validators applied to Query fields. Adding an annotated example with @field_validator would help users.

title: Memory leak when using many concurrent streaming responses
body: Under heavy concurrent load with hundreds of simultaneous StreamingResponse connections, memory usage grows unboundedly. Profiling shows the generator objects are not being garbage collected after the stream completes. Reproduced consistently at 200+ concurrent connections.

title: Route tags not properly serialized in OpenAPI when using Enum
body: When route tags are defined using a Python Enum, the OpenAPI JSON output contains the Enum object representation instead of the string value. This breaks code generators that consume the schema.

title: Support injecting Request object into Pydantic validators
body: It would be useful to access the current Request object within a Pydantic model validator for context-dependent validation. Currently this requires passing the request through a separate dependency.

title: Response caching middleware example in documentation
body: A cookbook example for implementing response caching in middleware would help production deployments. The community has multiple approaches but official guidance is missing.

title: Make error response schema customizable globally
body: Currently the 422 Unprocessable Entity response schema is hardcoded. A configuration option on FastAPI() to override the validation error response model would allow API consumers to have consistent error schemas across different frameworks.

title: Race condition in concurrent dependency resolution
body: When the same use_cache=True dependency is awaited from multiple concurrent requests simultaneously, there's a window where it can be resolved twice. This causes double initialization of singletons like database connection pools.

title: Header alias not reflected in OpenAPI schema
body: When using Header(alias='X-Custom-Header'), the OpenAPI documentation shows the Python variable name instead of the alias. Swagger UI then sends requests with the wrong header name.

title: Contribute a Turkish translation for the documentation
body: I would like to contribute a Turkish translation of the main documentation pages. Turkish is widely spoken and a localized version would make FastAPI more accessible.
